video_title: Deni Avdija Media Availability | Oct. 18, 2026 | Portland Trail Blazers

quotes.speaker: Deni Avdija
quotes.summary_phrase: Deni Avdija on the Portland Trail Blazers' new coaching staff
quotes.excerpt: I think obviously we're a new team, new coaching staff and I feel like we did a good job.
quotes.quote: I think obviously we're a new team, new coaching staff and I feel like we did a good job, decent job. It was mainly just to have our chemistry together, play together, feel each other out, know the roles. I think we did a good job, we played for each other, we shared the ball, we had some good wins. Yeah, I mean we're going into the season with a good spirit I feel like.
quotes.social_post: Deni Avdija says the Blazers are focused on building chemistry and learning their roles as they head into the new season with a new coaching staff.

quotes.speaker: Deni Avdija
quotes.summary_phrase: Deni Avdija on the versatility of the Portland Trail Blazers' roster
quotes.excerpt: I think we're very versatile, we have a lot of players that can play multiple positions.
quotes.quote: I think we're very versatile, we have a lot of players that can play multiple positions, they can put pressure on the rim, they can play defense. I feel like everybody's mind is there and you know obviously the coaching staff is going to do the best job they can to put us in a great situations and you know we're just going to rock and roll with the lineups. I feel like every lineup got their pros and cons and we're just going to rock with it for sure.
quotes.social_post: Deni Avdija highlights the versatility of the Blazers roster noting that many players can play multiple positions and contribute on both ends of the floor.

quotes.speaker: Deni Avdija
quotes.summary_phrase: Deni Avdija on his goal to improve defensively this season
quotes.excerpt: My plan is to take another step defensively, especially this year.
quotes.quote: My plan is to take another step defensively, especially this year. And it's something that I want to do, I want to be a great two-way player, so I think that's the next step for sure.
quotes.social_post: Deni Avdija has a clear goal for the upcoming season as he looks to take another step defensively and establish himself as a great two way player.

quotes.speaker: Deni Avdija
quotes.summary_phrase: Deni Avdija on the coaching staff's expectations for player development
quotes.excerpt: He expects the best out of everybody and he want to push us to be the best.
quotes.quote: He expects the best out of everybody and he want to push us to be the best, the best version of ourselves and like that's what he's doing with everybody and me included.
quotes.social_post: Deni Avdija says the coaching staff is pushing every player on the roster to be the best version of themselves this season.

quotes.speaker: Deni Avdija
quotes.summary_phrase: Deni Avdija on the importance of sacrifice for winning teams
quotes.excerpt: When you put a lot of talent together, everybody got to sacrifice.
quotes.quote: When you put a lot of talent together, everybody got to sacrifice and do something they're less capable of and step up defensively and maybe sometimes play off the ball and it's part of the game and that's what's going to make us great so. Yeah, it's part of life, we're focused on winning and whatever we got to do to make this organization a winning organization, a winning team, I think everybody would be sacrifice and put aside everything they have because you know in the end of the day the guys that get paid the most are the winners, so everybody understands that.
quotes.social_post: Deni Avdija emphasizes the importance of sacrifice for the Blazers to succeed saying that in the end the guys that get paid the most are the winners.

quotes.speaker: Deni Avdija
quotes.summary_phrase: Deni Avdija on the need for better rebounding and boxing out
quotes.excerpt: We're way smaller, so for sure everybody got to box out.
quotes.quote: We're way smaller, so for sure everybody got to box out and as I said sacrifice and put their body on the line, box out and yeah it's a team collective job for sure.
quotes.social_post: Deni Avdija notes that because the Blazers are a smaller team this year it will be a team collective job to box out and put their bodies on the line.
